create_CsmProcessor: create a CsmProcessor instance with a feature extractor and tokenizer for audio-text processing
process_text_and_audio: process text prompts with audio tokens and corresponding audio inputs using CsmProcessor to produce tokenized batch features
save_audio_files: save processed audio tensors to disk as WAV files using CsmProcessor.save_audio with soundfile backend
compute_encoded_audio_length: compute the encoded audio sequence length from raw audio samples given convolutional kernel sizes, strides, and dilations
generate_training_labels: generate training labels with audio token IDs, -100 for ignored tokens, and -101 for depth decoder frames from CsmProcessor output
